label: Coverage-explicit worldview elimination with two-world control (inference)
rule: Unfolding semantic consistency; case split on the covering candidate; evaluation in the existing two-world interpretation
meaning: Reuses ReflectiveCoherence's Consistent, Models and two-world control.
